subject: Re: IGT optimizer kickoff - staffing + evaluation harness build
body:
Ximena,

Resourcing:

- Staffing: Efe 50%, Halima 40%, Emeka 60%, Bilal 40% through April 13.
- Compute: multi-seed ResNet runs are the cost - 5 seeds x 4 optimizer configs. We'll use 32 titan-a100 best-effort; the released framework is a fork of TPU-era resnet code, and Emeka has it running fine on GPU.

One build item to be upfront about: we're standing up an internal evaluation harness from scratch for optimizer comparisons - multi-seed orchestration, variance-across-seeds metrics, and curve alignment that correctly handles IGT's true-vs-shifted parameter distinction (eval_igt mode evaluates at the true parameters stored in slots, and naive comparisons silently plot the shifted ones - we nearly got burned by that in week one). Nothing we have does seed-variance reporting properly, so Emeka owns the build at 60% with Bilal at 40%, about five weeks.

That harness is most of Emeka's allocation, but it's also the reusable artifact this project leaves behind.

Bao
